items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Yeah, it was. Yeah, yeah. Alvin Alcon, Boyd Banks, Octave Crosby, Jimmy Davis.

ctx.x: And you went out there, let's see. It was Octave's band. You remember who was with you?

Yeah, it was. Yeah, yeah. Alvin Alcon, Boyd Banks, Octave Crosby, Jimmy Davis. Well Nelson was supposed to make the trip but his wife was sick during the time he didn't go. So, the wife followed out there by the name of Cajun. He used him on the travel. Oh Cajun? Yeah, Cajun. He worked with us.
And did you ever make any records?
